author: kkoryun
title: PyTorch Layer Tests test_tile fails - builtin cannot be used as a value in TorchScript scripting
signature: builtin cannot be used as a value|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Pytorch Layer Tests / PyTorch Layer Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_tile.py::TestTile::test_tile[dims:(1, 2, 3, 4)] fails: TorchScript scripting raises RuntimeError 'builtin cannot be used as a value' for torch.tile(x, self.dims)

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check fails because the PyTorch Layer Tests job failed

root_cause: torch.jit.script() fails to compile test_tile's forward() because `self.dims` is passed as the second positional argument to torch.tile, and the installed PyTorch version's TorchScript compiler treats `torch.tile` as a builtin that cannot be referenced/resolved this way when scripting (rather than tracing) the aten_tile test module. This is the same 'builtin cannot be used as a value' TorchScript scripting incompatibility previously seen for reflection_pad-style tests (pattern 98cbf832e7e217cf, 2 prior occurrences), now reproduced for torch.tile; it is unrelated to the PR under test (an NPUW GQA weight-detection change) and is a pre-existing layer-test/TorchScript-version incompatibility in src/bindings or install/tests/layer_tests/pytorch_tests that a merge-queue rerun cannot fix.
reproduction_steps: cd install/tests/layer_tests && python -m pytest pytorch_tests/test_tile.py::TestTile::test_tile -k 'dims3' -v  (reproduce locally with the same PyTorch/torch.jit version installed in CI; failure occurs during torch.jit.script(), not during OpenVINO conversion itself)
recommended_actions: Mark test_tile's dims=(1,2,3,4) scripting-mode parametrization as xfail/skip for the installed PyTorch version until the TorchScript scripting incompatibility with torch.tile is resolved, mirroring the existing xfail markers already used for other scripting-incompatible ops in this suite
Update test_tile.py to force trace_model=True (or pass example_input) for this parametrization so TorchScriptPythonDecoder uses tracing instead of scripting, avoiding the builtin-resolution issue
File/track a PyTorch-version-tracking issue to re-enable scripting coverage for torch.tile once the upstream TorchScript compiler issue is fixed or the project pins a different torch version
prevention_strategies: Layer tests that rely on torch.jit.script() for specific aten ops should carry an explicit compatibility check or regression test against new PyTorch versions before upgrades land, and new/changed test parametrizations for ops with known scripting limitations (e.g. torch.tile) should default to trace_model=True unless scripting coverage is specifically required.
historical_context: This is the 3rd recorded occurrence of pattern 98cbf832e7e217cf ('builtin cannot be used as a value', Code Issue). Prior occurrences: 2026-09-01 (PR #37790) and 2026-11-10 (PR #39577), both on different ops (reflection_pad-style). All three are deterministic TorchScript-scripting incompatibilities with specific aten ops under the installed PyTorch version, not retry-fixable, and unrelated to the PRs that happened to be in the merge queue at the time.
